title: Concept bench morphologies
description: One row per morphology in the swarm's catalogue: status, the agent's claimed bench numbers, the verifier's re-measured numbers (v_), its best sweep configuration so far, and the 3R baseline once (is_baseline). Built from docs/concepts/catalogue.json, families.json, rows/*.json and sweeps/*.json.

title: Concept bench sweeps
description: Every configuration a morphology agent evaluated on the concept bench, with its time, gap, its morphology's best gap so far (best_gap) and the record over all morphologies so far (record_gap); passed_over marks a configuration its agent measured before its claimed row and rejected (better than the claim), which counts for no best. Built from docs/concepts/sweeps/*.json; a morphology with more than 1500 configurations is thinned for the page (every running-best and record row, its 300 best gaps and an even sample of the rest), while best_gap, record_gap and n_configs come from the full set.

title: Built CAD judge results
description: One row per judged design and requirement: value, threshold and pass from the outside judges, timed by the judge output (score files: the earliest of their commit, their file time and the first commit whose docs report the design; scorecard-only values: the scorecard's commit). Built from tools/judged_history.py, judge/scorecard.json files and judge/requirements.json.

title: GPU evaluator detail runs
description: Every GPU band-evaluator detail evaluation of a search candidate (in-band 14 mm, follow, workspace share, overhead follow). Time is the git commit that added the result file, not the run itself. Built from pipeline/conformal/gpu_client/band_eval_*.json via tools/judged_history.py --evals.

title: GPU band searches
description: One row per GPU search job: its final best fitness, follow, generations, evaluations and seconds. Time is the git commit that added the result file. Built from pipeline/conformal/gpu_client/band_search_*.json.

title: Requirement board
description: Latest status of R1-R17 (with R1-aim and R5-aim) for the best judged 3-DOF design (most passes on its scorecard, then R1), with the best value any 3-DOF design reached under the current judging rules. Built from judge/scorecard.json files and judge/requirements.json.

title: Event log
description: What happened and when: the swarm's own log (docs/concepts/events.jsonl), one milestone per judged design and every new built-CAD R1 record (from the judge outputs).

title: GPU spend log
description: RunPod balance and cumulative spend at each logged audit. Built from docs/RUNPOD_COSTS.md (audit rows only).

title: Arm reach in 3-D
description: One row per built design and everyday arm pose of the R16 workspace judge: where the upper arm points and whether the built design reaches it, with the reason if not. Built by tools/coverage3d.py from judge/workspace.json files (newest 8 designs).

title: Motion previews
description: Tiny monochrome previews of each concept's mechanism moving with the arm through the gallery's motion loop (frames spaced by equal travel of the arm and the mechanisms, one fixed camera for all), as SVG paths per frame ('=' repeats the frame before); generated by docs/concepts/viz/thumbs.mjs from the concept kinematics (docs/concepts/viz/kin.js and concepts/*.js).

title: Data build info
description: When tools/dash_build.py last gathered the data, the repo commit, and any warnings it printed.
